name: MDM RT (x64)
author: hamed7ir
description: MDM RT is my unofficial fork of Ahmed Nefzaoui's Mister Download Manager 0.5.2, made for old ARM Windows tablets, and he doesn't make or support it. This is its x64 build for 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, with ThinLTO. It downloads files, videos and torrents (magnet links too), resumes after a dropped connection, and has queues with a scheduler. For videos it gets the official yt-dlp and FFmpeg itself, like Mister Download Manager does. The browser extension works in Venetium, Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox. It has 7-Zip RT's dark look in Kodi RT purple, or another colour, and its own data folder and settings, so it can sit next to an official Mister Download Manager. The ARM32 build for the Surface RT and Surface 2 is a separate entry.
dependencies: .NET Framework 4.0 or newer, only for the installer. Windows 10 and 11 already have it.
instructionSteps: Run MDM-RT-Setup-0.5.2-x64.exe. It installs only for your user (to %LocalAppData%\Programs\MDM RT) and doesn't need admin. In the setup you pick your colour, and whether browsers hand downloads to MDM RT, whether it starts with Windows, and whether you want a desktop shortcut.
The files are not signed, so SmartScreen warns the first time. Click More info, then Run anyway.

To catch downloads from your browser, use Add Mister Download Manager to your browser in MDM RT. It lists Venetium first, and the setup already registers MDM RT for Venetium, Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox.
For video downloads, MDM RT offers to download the official yt-dlp and FFmpeg the first time you need them.
Help > Check for updates asks GitHub for a newer MDM RT. Update now downloads the new setup, checks its SHA-256 and runs it, and your choices stay.
Uninstalling (from Control Panel or Settings > Apps) keeps your download list and settings in %AppData%\mdm-rt.
